seo_title: Date Night Charcuterie Board Ideas: 27 Boards for Two
h1: Date Night Charcuterie Board Ideas for Two
description: 27 charcuterie board ideas for two: date night, anniversary, Valentine's, movie night, brunch and splurge boards, with what goes on each and a drink.
answer: A charcuterie board for two needs two cheeses, two meats, one crunchy thing, one fresh fruit and one sweet bite, on a 12 to 16 inch board. Plan about 4 oz of cheese and 4 oz of meat in total before dinner, or 6 oz of each when the board is the meal. Below are 27 complete boards for two, grouped by occasion.
intro: A board for two isn't a party board cut down. With only two people, every item has to earn its place, so these boards use fewer, better things and one drink chosen to go with them.
Each idea below links to the full board: what goes on it, why it works and the timeline. Most cost $25 to $60 for two.

ideas.heading: Date night and romance
ideas.intro: For the nights when the board is part of the plan.

boards.name: Date Night Charcuterie Board
boards.best_for: A classic date night at home
boards.blurb: Brie, aged Gouda and chèvre with truffle honey, prosciutto and bresaola, figs, strawberries and dark chocolate. The one to start with.

boards.name: First Date Board
boards.best_for: An early date that shouldn't look like you tried too hard
boards.blurb: Manchego, brie, prosciutto and soppressata with Castelvetrano olives and Marcona almonds. Built in 20 minutes, with a glass of Cava.

boards.name: Anniversary Board
boards.blurb: 12-month Manchego, Taleggio, San Daniele prosciutto and bresaola with honeycomb and Medjool dates, and a Nebbiolo to pour.

boards.name: Valentine's Day Board
boards.blurb: Triple-crème brie, prosciutto roses, strawberries, raspberries and dark chocolate, with sparkling rosé.

boards.name: Proposal Night Board
boards.blurb: Aged Comté, Brillat-Savarin, jamón ibérico and blinis with crème fraîche and roe, with Champagne. The most expensive board here, on purpose.

boards.name: Honeymoon Suite Board
boards.best_for: A trip, or a hotel room
boards.blurb: Aged Gouda, Manchego, smoked duck, prosciutto, lychees and mango. Tropical and easy to put together anywhere.

boards.name: Keto Date Night Board
boards.blurb: Brie, Manchego, prosciutto and soppressata on endive, with berries, macadamias and 90% dark chocolate.

ideas.heading: Cozy nights in
ideas.intro: Low effort, high comfort. Most of these cost under $40.

boards.name: Cozy Night In Board
boards.best_for: A cold night and a blanket
boards.blurb: Gruyère, smoked Gouda, soppressata and speck with honeycomb, candied walnuts and apple, and a full-bodied red or dry cider.

boards.name: Movie Night Board
boards.blurb: Sharp white cheddar, pepper jack, pepperoni and salami next to butter popcorn, chocolate pretzels and peanut butter cups.

boards.name: Game Night Snack Board
boards.blurb: Smoked Gouda, pepper jack, spicy salami and summer sausage with hot honey, pickles and pretzel bites. Nothing greasy on the cards.

boards.name: Midnight Indulgence Board
boards.blurb: Blue cheese, triple-crème brie, prosciutto and fennel salami with dark chocolate, dried figs and shortbread, and a glass of port.

boards.name: Lazy Sunday Grazing Board
boards.blurb: Brie, cheddar, Genoa salami and smoked turkey with hummus, vegetables, green apple and pita chips. Built in 15 minutes.

boards.name: 'Just Because' Board
boards.blurb: Sharp cheddar, a small brie, salami, apple, grapes, nuts and honey, mostly from what's in the fridge. About $12 to $22.

boards.name: 'I'm Sorry' Board
boards.blurb: Their favorite cheese, their favorite meat and their crackers, plus dark chocolate and berries. How to build an apology on a board.

boards.name: Breakfast in Bed Board
boards.blurb: Brie, Gruyère, prosciutto, mini croissants, berries, Greek yogurt and granola, with coffee and juice.

boards.name: Morning After Brunch Board
boards.blurb: Smoked salmon, whipped cream cheese, herbed goat cheese, mini bagels, eggs and capers, with mimosas.

boards.name: Italian Antipasto Board
boards.blurb: Burrata, Parmigiano, provolone, prosciutto, soppressata and mortadella with artichokes and olives, and Chianti Classico.

boards.name: Spanish Tapas Board
boards.best_for: Tapas and a bottle of Rioja
boards.blurb: Aged Manchego, jamón serrano, chorizo, membrillo, Marcona almonds, piquillo peppers and pan con tomate.

boards.name: French Bistro Board
boards.blurb: Brie, Comté, pâté de campagne, saucisson sec, baguette, salted butter, cornichons and Dijon.

boards.name: Mediterranean Mezze Board
boards.blurb: Grilled halloumi, feta, hummus, tzatziki, dolmas, olives and warm pita. No meat at all.

ideas.heading: Splurge boards
ideas.intro: For a celebration, or just because the week deserved it.

boards.name: Oysters & Champagne Board
boards.blurb: A dozen oysters on ice, chilled shrimp, Comté, mignonette and baguette with salted butter.

boards.name: Caviar & Crème Fraîche Board
boards.best_for: New Year's or a big night
boards.blurb: Caviar or trout roe on ice with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, blini or potato chips and Champagne. Trout roe keeps the cost down.

boards.name: Truffle & Aged Cheese Board
boards.blurb: 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano, a truffle cheese, prosciutto di Parma, truffle salami, aged balsamic and truffle honey.

boards.name: Whiskey & Smoke Board
boards.blurb: Aged cheddar, smoked blue or smoked Gouda, brisket or jerky, andouille, candied pecans and bacon jam.

boards.name: Birthday Board
boards.blurb: Brie, aged Gouda, Genoa salami and prosciutto with macarons, chocolate truffles and strawberries, and Champagne or Crémant.

boards.name: New Year's Eve Board
boards.blurb: Triple-crème brie, aged Gouda, prosciutto, smoked salmon, blini and chocolate truffles, plus 12 grapes each for midnight.

boards.name: Summer Picnic Board
boards.blurb: Fresh mozzarella, aged cheddar, prosciutto, Genoa salami, cherry tomatoes, melon, strawberries and pesto.

sections.heading: What to put on a charcuterie board for two
paras: Every board above follows the same short list. Pick one from each line.

items.text: One soft (brie, chèvre, burrata) and one firm or aged (Manchego, aged Gouda, Comté).
One silky (prosciutto, bresaola) and one sliced salami (soppressata, Genoa, chorizo).
Crackers, crostini or a few slices of baguette.
Grapes, figs, berries or apple, for color and to reset your mouth between bites.
Honey, fig jam or a square of dark chocolate.

sections.heading: How much for two
paras: Before dinner, plan about 4 oz of cheese and 4 oz of meat in total, the Lab standard of 2 oz of each per person. When the board is dinner, make it about 6 oz of each.

A 12 to 16 inch board is the right size. Anything bigger looks empty, and a smaller board packed tight looks more generous. For other guest counts, use the [Party Planner](/party-planner/). For the how-to, see [how to make a charcuterie board for two](/blog/charcuterie-board-two/).

faq.q: What goes on a charcuterie board for two?
faq.a: Two cheeses, two meats, one crunchy thing, one fresh fruit, one briny extra and one sweet bite. For example: brie and aged Gouda, prosciutto and soppressata, crackers, grapes, olives and honey.

faq.q: How much charcuterie do I need for two people?
faq.a: About 4 oz of cheese and 4 oz of meat in total before dinner. If the board is the meal, plan about 6 oz of each.

faq.q: What size board do I need for two?
faq.a: A 12 to 16 inch board, or even a large plate. A small board packed full looks better than a big board with gaps.

faq.q: How much does a charcuterie board for two cost?
faq.a: Most of the boards above cost $25 to $60. The 'Just Because' board is about $12 to $22, and the splurge boards with oysters, caviar or jamón ibérico cost more.

faq.q: What should we drink with a date night board?
faq.a: Each board above names one. Sparkling wine like Cava or Champagne goes with almost any board, a Pinot Noir suits salami and soft cheese, and port is good with blue cheese and chocolate.
